recommended_actions_shared:
- Try forcing requests to us-east-1 region.
- Enable streaming where client UX tolerates it.
- Increase client timeout to 6s and add exponential backoff capped at 2 retries.
- Reduce prompt length: move static KB to embeddings and fetch top-k.
- Use model with lower compute profile (e.g., redwood-medium) and enable quantized variant if available.
